rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not reasonable or fair.

example.english: It is unreasonable for my boss to expect me to finish this report today.
example.traditional: 老闆要我今日內做晒呢份報告，真係唔合理。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 jiu3 ngo5 gam1 jat6 noi6 zou6 saai3 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan1 hai6 m4 hap6 lei5

rows.note: Use this when the unreasonable thing is an excessive demand, amount, or action.

example.english: Charging me so much for the moving service is unreasonable.
example.traditional: 你收我咁貴嘅搬屋費，真係過分。
example.jyutping: nei5 sau1 ngo5 gam3 gwai3 ge3 bun1 uk1 fai3 zan1 hai6 gwo3 fan6

rows.note: Use this colloquial word when something is outrageously or absurdly beyond what is acceptable.

example.english: Selling a cup of milk tea for that much is unreasonable.
example.traditional: 一杯奶茶賣到咁貴，真係離譜。
example.jyutping: jat1 bui1 naai5 caa4 maai6 dou3 gam3 gwai3 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2
